subject: geom_smooth error when faceting on variable called "start"

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: geom_smooth error when faceting on variable called "start"
parts:
This is curious. The following code runs fine for me:

set.seed(123)
dat <-
data.frame(x=runif(200),y=runif(200),strt=rep(c('A','B','C','D'),times=25))
ggplot(dat,aes(x=x,y=y)) +
geom_point() +
facet_wrap(~strt) +
geom_smooth()

However, this produces an error:

set.seed(123)
dat <-
data.frame(x=runif(200),y=runif(200),start=rep(c('A','B','C','D'),times=25))
ggplot(dat,aes(x=x,y=y)) +
geom_point() +
facet_wrap(~start) +
geom_smooth()

Specifically: "Error in grid.Call.graphics("L_lines", x$x, x$y, index,
x$arrow) :
invalid line type"

Now that I've figured it out, it's easy enough not to call my
variables "start", but I thought I'd share in case this snagged anyone
else.

Hi Joran,

I think this is a bit of a general caution in ggplot2 and R----there
can be unexpected consequences of using function names as variables.
This happens to me about once a week that I forget to avoid function
names.

Cheers,

Josh
